description:
Export account transactions from a portfolio to a CSV file. A portfolio file with multiple cash account transactions (deposits, interest, and a withdrawal) is available at /home/ga/Documents/PortfolioData/diversified_portfolio.xml. Open this file in Portfolio Performance if it is not already open.

Export the cash account (Main Brokerage (USD)) transactions to a CSV file. In Portfolio Performance, navigate to the Deposit Accounts section, select the account, then use File > Export > CSV to export the account transactions. Save the exported file as /home/ga/Documents/PortfolioData/account_export.csv. The exported CSV should contain columns for Date, Type, and Value/Amount.
